name: @velajs/client-workspace
description: Workspace for the Vela client SDK (@velajs/client) and framework bindings (@velajs/react)

scripts.release:preflight: npm view @velajs/live-protocol@1.1.0 version && npm view @velajs/vela@1.21.0 version
scripts.release:check: node scripts/check-release-lock.mjs && pnpm verify && pnpm audit --audit-level=high
scripts.release: pnpm release:preflight && pnpm release:check && changeset publish
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm publint && pnpm attw
